//: Grafana dashboard for the QSH pipeline. docker-compose.yml has bind-mounted ../monitoring/grafana into the provisioning path since Round 1, but the directory did not exist, so Docker silently created a root-owned empty one and no dashboard was ever provisioned. Panels below read the metrics qsh.monitoring.exporter actually emits.
title: QSH — quantum-safe pipeline

panels.title: Stage latency p95 (ms)
panels.description: p95 over the last five minutes, read from a histogram whose bucket bounds are about 2.5x apart, so a stage that ran once reads an interpolated value inside its bucket, not its exact time. Stages that did not run in the window are hidden.

panels.title: QBER
panels.description: Quantum bit error rate from the most recent QKD stage; empty until one has run. The BB84 secure threshold is 11%; sustained values above it mean the key must be discarded.

panels.title: Benchmark latency, mean per backend (ms)
panels.description: Mean of the measured benchmark rows since the API started, per path and backend: MPC-FHE is linear layers under CKKS and the non-linear ones under MPyC, on TenSEAL, OpenFHE and HEonGPU where built; QSMPC-FHE is the QOTP and QCNN state-vector simulation. The extrapolated 'large' tier is not recorded. A sum over count is exact; a quantile of two rows would read a bucket bound.
